_about: t20_base.json with the stride-4 lane branch OFF (model.lane_branch "") and loss.fusion_area_only true (D31, Mirko 2026-11-10: "Schränke die Evaluierung auf den Sichtbereich des Netzwerkes ein. Auch beim Loss.": no loss outside the fusion area on the fused heads, D37 / D38), nothing else changed (D65, Mirko 2026-11-08: "remove it", scope chosen: off for new runs; t7 gave the branch +0.054 lane divider IoU@0.5 in the old chain, the t20 bundle with it was a TIE against t16_full, and it was never switched off on its own). A from-scratch base run: the fine-tune chains t21 / t22 / t23 warm-start from runs/t20_base_s0, whose checkpoint holds the branch, and keep it. lane_images stays (the t22 student reads the same image cache). Preview (nothing starts): the job {"id": "t20.base_nol4_s0", "config": "training/configs/t20_base_nol4.json", "no_card": true} through cd autoresearch && AR_PROJECT=../bev_fusion python3 -m Training check job.json. Original _about of t20_base.json: t20 base (D48, card experiments/t20_lane_grid_bundle/experiment.md): t16_full.json plus the bundle of the card. (1) L4: model.lane_branch res4, the frozen ResNet-50 stem + layer 1 at stride 4 on the current frame (lane_images = the key-frame image cache data/cache/img_front, which holds exactly the samples of the large split), lifted with the DualBEV depth and added to the merged dual camera BEV after the temporal block. (2) The 1 m centre-line head in the map head (centreline_1m in the loss and the model; they must agree). (3) The hygiene fixes of records/open_findings_2026-11-02.md (loss.hygiene_2026_11_02: #1 #2 #3 #6) and the dead radar-stationary channel removed (radar_stationary false in the loss and the model, open finding #4: the radar aux head loses one output channel, once, here). (4) The split by name: "split": "large" instead of the 428 / 82 inline scene lists of t16_full.json (the same lists, splits/large.json), so that the config says which sequences it trains on and not 510 names. The trainer does not read the key: `python -m Training check` / `run` resolves it into train_scenes / val_scenes before it writes the composed config (splits/README.md), so the run's config.json holds the exact lists; a direct `python training/train.py` on this file stops with 'unknown key'. Nothing else differs from t16_full.json (6000 steps, accum 2, seed 0, the motion block, delta slots, probe). Short bug-finding twin: the same job with `"preset": ["small"], "set": {"split": "small", "steps": 600}` (splits/README.md).
